Hampus Serneke

I am a M.Sc. student in Data Science at EPFL, Switzerland. I have a background in Engineering Mathematics from Lund University, Sweden, and I was previously a Summer Undergraduate Research Fellow at Caltech. I am interested in reinforcement learning, computer vision, robotics and AI safety.
